meta.prompt: Build a small checkout in three steps: my cart (three items with quantities), a shipping form (name, address, city, postcode, email, all checked, with messages under the fields), then a payment summary with a choice of standard or express delivery changing the total, and a confirmation screen with an order number. I can go back a step without losing what I typed.
meta.text:
The error came from the visible prop being written on its own indented line under the Button. In the notation, props go on the same line as the node, so I've moved it there. I've also fixed the other problems: the summary's Items line had no value, and the delivery total used a ternary that isn't supported, so I used an if block instead.

state step=1
state qty1=1
state qty2=2
state qty3=1
state name=""
state address=""
state city=""
state postcode=""
state email=""
state delivery="standard"
state orderNo="ORD-20417"
Column gap:16 pad:16 w:390
  if step==1
    Text.title "Your cart"
    Card gap:10
      Row between
        Text "Wireless headphones"
        Text.strong "\$79"
      Row gap:8
        Button.outline "-" -> qty1=max(1,qty1-1)
        Text.strong "{qty1}"
        Button.outline "+" -> qty1=qty1+1
    Card gap:10
      Row between
        Text "Phone case"
        Text.strong "\$18"
      Row gap:8
        Button.outline "-" -> qty2=max(1,qty2-1)
        Text.strong "{qty2}"
        Button.outline "+" -> qty2=qty2+1
    Card gap:10
      Row between
        Text "USB-C cable"
        Text.strong "\$12"
      Row gap:8
        Button.outline "-" -> qty3=max(1,qty3-1)
        Text.strong "{qty3}"
        Button.outline "+" -> qty3=qty3+1
    Button "Continue to shipping" -> step=2

  if step==2
    Text.title "Shipping"
    Input "Full name" "Jane Doe" =name
    if name==""
      Text.danger "Name is required."
    Input "Address" "12 High Street" =address
    if address==""
      Text.danger "Address is required."
    Input "City" "London" =city
    if city==""
      Text.danger "City is required."
    Input "Postcode" "SW1A 1AA" =postcode
    if postcode==""
      Text.danger "Postcode is required."
    Input "Email" "you@example.com" =email
    if email==""
      Text.danger "Email is required."
    Row gap:8
      Button.outline "Back" -> step=1
      Spacer grow
      Button "Continue to payment" visible:=name!=""&&address!=""&&city!=""&&postcode!=""&&email!="" -> step=3; emit shipping

  if step==3
    Text.title "Payment summary"
    Card gap:10
      Text.strong "Delivery"
      Radio "Standard (3-5 days, \$0)" =delivery
      Radio "Express (1 day, \$9)" =delivery
    Card gap:8
      Row between
        Text "Items"
        Text "\$112"
      Row between
        Text "Delivery"
        Text "\$0"
        if delivery=="express"
          Text.strong "\$9"
    Row gap:8
      Button.outline "Back" -> step=2
      Spacer grow
      Button "Place order" -> step=4; emit placeOrder

  if step==4
    Card gap:12 pad:24
      Text.title "Thank you!"
      Text.body "Your order is confirmed."
      Badge.success "Order {orderNo}"
      Button "Back to cart" -> step=1

delta: on the same line as the node,
